worldcombat.skill.shelter.summary: Raise Defense and gain a damage-absorbing barrier. This Defense increase ends when the barrier breaks, is removed or expires.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.use.0: Close the shell before a burst lands and eat the round
worldcombat.skill.shelter.use.1: Use a shell that breaks to make the opponent spend extra hits
worldcombat.skill.shelter.use.2: Shell up at low health to wait for a partner or a cooldown
worldcombat.skill.shelter.description.0: While the shell holds, Defense is raised by %1$s level(s); the shell absorbs up to %2$s of maximum health and lasts about %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.description.1: It cracks once its budget is spent.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.seal.on: Iron shield: a thicker, longer shell, but rooted in place for the whole window, with a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.seal.off: Curl: a thinner, shorter shell, but you can walk with it and the wind-up and cooldown are shorter; it shields less and preserves position.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.growth.0: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.growth.1: At level %1$s the shell lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.shelter.preference.sea: On: a thicker, longer shell, but rooted in place for the whole window, a slower wind-up and a longer cooldown. Off: a curl with a thinner, shorter shell that you can walk with and a shorter wind-up and cooldown.
The companion considers closing the shell only when a threat is within this distance; larger predicts earlier and may waste it, smaller saves it but may be too late.
Below this health ratio, and up close, the companion shells up ahead of the shared order; higher enters the turtle stance earlier, lower only when nearly down.
